module: Flowgraph node "Race Markers" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario). Displays in 3D (module scenario/race_marker) the race markers of a vehicle and draws the same points on the minimap. On first flow with raceData, creates one marker per pathnode (position, radius, normal, position of the next one); on each rollingStarted/pathnodeReached/raceStarted event of the vehicle, recomputes the modes (default, next, start, lap, recovery, final, branch, hidden) from state.nextPathnodes and overNextPathnodes. Inputs: clear (pulse that removes the markers), raceData, vehId, ignoreRecovery, minAlpha (0.15), maxAlpha (1), minDistance (5), maxDistance (50), alwaysShowFinal.
notes: The pins minAlpha, maxAlpha, minDistance, maxDistance are declared but never read in this file.
The old pin 'reset' is redirected to 'clear'.
A stray "]]" remains in the code (leftover of a commented-out block).

work.desc: Handles clear; creates the markers if needed and updates their modes on race events.

onMinimapRouteOverride.desc: Minimap hook: adds to routeOverrides a copy of the race's detailed path aiDetailedPath (closed again if it is closed).

onDrawOnMinimap.desc: Minimap hook: draws a line (pathnode with normal) or a circle for each non-hidden marker, with an edge pointer.

_executionStopped.desc: Destroys the markers (markers.onClientEndMission) and empties the route.
